data.body:
Baseline full-suite run (make test equivalent: pytest -m 'not integration and not external') in progress in the worktree before any edit, to capture the pre-split test count required by the ticket's operator-attested AC. New module drafted and staged outside the worktree at /tmp/c6c9_remediation_mode.py so the running suite is not contaminated.

Note: an earlier UNFILTERED 'pytest -q -x' run in this worktree failed at tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py::test_delete_permission_probe ('created issue REB-2411 never became index-visible') — a live-Jira eventual-consistency flake, pre-existing and unrelated to this refactor. That test is excluded from the CI-gating 'make test' selection (-m 'not integration and not external').
